highlights.title: Your message shows on every open screen
highlights.text: Send from your Mac and your phone shows it right away, above the bot's work. A follow-up you send from your phone shows up on your Mac too.

highlights.title: More room to read in every chat
highlights.text: One chip under the message box now shows who answers. Tap it to pick another bot. The tip line leaves after your first message, and suggestions stay hidden while a bot replies.
